title: Improve processes
goal: One change is in force at the process the measures say is the bottleneck, the method chosen for it is recorded, and the measure that will show whether the change worked is named with the date it will be read.

steps.do: Rank the active processes by waiting time, rework rate and the postmortem actions open against each, and bring the founder the three with the clearest cost, each with what the venture would get back and what the change would take.

Lay out for the founder the ways this improvement could be worked, measuring and removing the slowest step, cutting the rework at one control point, or dropping the process, with what each costs and what it risks, and record the method the founder picks on the process record.
Open one handoff for the change with its done criteria, the step it touches and the measure that will judge it, and keep the handoff current as the work moves, changing one thing at a time.

Once the change is in force, rewrite the affected steps of the process record, read the measure again after the number of runs agreed in advance, and write whether the change helped, did nothing or hurt.
Record the before and after measures as evidence on the handoff, and raise to the strategy lead whether to keep the change, undo it or take the next bottleneck.

done_criteria.check: Is exactly one change in force, at the process the measures named as the bottleneck, with the measure and the date that will show whether it worked?
